name: Nagyveleg (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and red in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Nagyveleg (a blue shield with a figure and a Hungarian shield) between the year 1999 above and the name NAGYVELEG below in green.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
